meta.title: Agent2B
meta.description: Agent console for supply-chain data. Language models route and narrate; code computes.

roleSummary.admin: Everything, including restricted fields and every user's pending approvals.
roleSummary.operator: Runs reports, requests writes and approves their own, reads the audit log.
roleSummary.viewer: Read-only: runs reports and browses data. No writes, no audit log.

approval.title: Approval required
approval.why: This request changes data, so it runs only after you approve it.
approval.expired: This confirmation expired. Ask again to get a new one.
approval.notLatest: Only the latest pending confirmation can be approved here.
approval.errorExpired: This confirmation expired. Ask again to get a new one.
approval.errorConflict: This confirmation was already used or no longer matches the request.
approval.errorForbidden: Only the person who asked can approve this.
approval.errorTransport: The connection failed before the server answered. Try again: a confirmation runs at most once.
approval.errorAudit: The reply was lost, and the audit log couldn't be read to say what happened. Check Audit before asking again.
approval.checkingNote: The reply was lost and the confirmation is gone, so the audit log is being checked for what happened.
approval.fromAudit: From the audit log: the reply to the approval was lost in transit.
approval.elsewhereNote: It was approved, rejected or expired outside this page (in another tab or window, or by an admin), so it can't be used here.
approval.unconfirmedNone: It is no longer pending, and the audit log records no write or rejection for it: nothing was written.
approval.unconfirmedStarted: The write started, but the audit log has no result for it yet. Check Audit before asking again.

approvals.expiredNote: This confirmation expired. It leaves the list on the next refresh.
approvals.rejectOnly: Only the requester can approve. You can reject.
approvals.emptyBody: Writes never run without an explicit, one-time confirmation bound to the exact parameters. When Hub or an import asks to change data, the request waits here until its requester approves it.
approvals.mineBody: Approve to run the write once, exactly as shown. Reject to cancel it.
approvals.othersBody: You see these as an admin. Only the person who asked can approve them; you can reject them.
